name: Samlah
overview: Samlah is identified in Scripture as one of the ancient kings of Edom, specifically noted as reigning after the death of Hadad. The passages in Genesis 36:36-37 and 1 Chronicles 1:47-48 record that Samlah of Masrekah succeeded Hadad and was later succeeded by Saul of Rehoboth by the river, highlighting the succession of Edomite kings during this period. These verses provide a brief but clear historical account of the Edomite monarchy, emphasizing the continuity of leadership within this ancient nation.
